intro: On Guard in Stonetalon is an Alliance breadcrumb quest directing adventurers south from Ashenvale into the rugged Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil dispatches travelers to check on her scout friend, Kaela Shadowspear, who was sent into the crags alongside a gnome mage to monitor industrial incursions by the Venture Company.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. And other enemies of the night elves.

Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... A sign of trouble for sure.
Would you find her and report back to me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you've come from Ashenvale at the behest of Tara—how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.
It is a pleasure to meet you, friend.
